input.quote: 9.1 Accounting. Each Party will maintain materially complete and accurate accounting records related to this Agreement in accordance with GAAP. Each Party will retain such records for [***] after the earlier of expiration or early termination of this Agreement.
input.rationale: SFJ (counterparty) holds no audit, inspection or verification right against PB. Article 9 (Records) imposes only mutual record-keeping and retention duties (p0624, p0625) with no accompanying right of examination, and there is no payment/underpayment verification, royalty audit or systems-access mechanic anywhere in the Agreement. The provisions that use the word "audit" do not bind PB to an SFJ audit: Section 3.6.1 (p0321) requires each Party to audit its own Permitted Third Parties and share reports; Section 3.6.2 (p0322) is PB's own quality oversight of manufacturing facilities; Section 3.5.5 (p0318) is a mutual exchange of source-data-verification reports; Section 3.18.2 (p0367) is delivery of PB financial statements and an executive meeting, not an audit of PB's records or systems. Because no counterparty audit right binding us exists, the frequency, notice, cost-allocation and no-systems-access limits in the preferred position have nothing to constrain, and our exposure is better than the preferred outcome. We therefore treat this as compliant and propose no redline; creating an audit clause here would only hand SFJ a right it does not currently have.
